answer: A census bond stops bulk fake identities. Each identity files one return per epoch for a basalt plot: a cipher binding surveyor, plot, and epoch. Auditors re-survey an eighth; a wrong cipher, reused plot, or mismatched sable grain burns the 70-credit bond. First return 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 vs a 40,000 pool. One cipher cannot cover two plots, so rented surveys fail. An honest agent files once for 40, keeps its share.
